verses.text: A good name is worth more than piles of money. Being held in loving favor beats silver and gold.
Rich and poor have this in common: the LORD made them all.
Someone with good judgment sees danger and takes cover. The inexperienced keep going and pay for it.
Humility and reverence for the LORD bring wealth, honor, and life.
The road of the wicked is full of thorns and traps. Anyone who guards their life stays far from them.
Train a child in the way they should go. When they're old, they won't leave it.
The rich rule over the poor. The borrower serves the lender.
Plant wickedness and you'll harvest trouble. The rod you wield in anger will break.
Generous people will be blessed because they share their food with the poor.
Send away the mocker and the fighting goes with them. The arguments and insults will stop.
A person who loves a pure heart and speaks with grace will be the king's friend.
The LORD watches over knowledge and overturns the words of the unfaithful.
A slacker says, “There's a lion outside! I'll get killed out in the street!”
The words of an adulteress are a deep pit. Those under the LORD's anger fall in.
Foolishness is tied up in a child's heart. The rod of discipline drives it far away.
Oppress the poor to get ahead, or give to the rich, and either way you'll end up poor.
Listen closely to the words of wise people. Give your heart to what I'm teaching.
It's a joy to keep those words inside you and have them ready on your lips.
I'm teaching you today, yes, you, so you'll put your trust in the LORD.
Haven't I written thirty good sayings for you, full of advice and knowledge,
to teach you reliable words of truth so you can bring sound answers to the people who sent you?
Don't take advantage of poor people because they're poor. Don't crush people in need in court.
The LORD will take up their case and take the lives of those who rob them.
Don't make friends with someone who's quick to anger or keep company with someone who holds on to rage.
You might pick up their ways and set a trap for your own life.
Don't be one of those who shake hands on a pledge and guarantee someone else's debts.
If you can't pay, why risk having your bed taken out from under you?
Don't move the ancient boundary stone your ancestors set in place.
See someone skilled at their work? They'll serve kings and won't work for people no one knows.
